dedupe_keys.name: 即時地下水水位資料 sewerage and wastewater and flood

description: 即時地下水水位資料 [sewerage and wastewater and flood] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 經濟部水利署發布所屬分布之地下水觀測井所觀測之即時地下水水位資料，資料內容包括各觀測井站當下最新之觀測水位資料、觀測日期及時間、站號等。 地下水水位即時觀測資料為每10分鐘紀錄1筆，因此資料更新頻率最快為每10分鐘1次。 由於即時地下水水位資料為即時發布之原始資料，因此資料未經任何檢核及品管程序，且資料可能因訊號傳輸中斷、儀器故障等因素導... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
